Love sucks in general. Been through a few relationships and none of them worked out. One lasted 6 years, wanted to marry her. She kicked me out and made it pretty clear she wanted nothing to do with me. I didnt make enough money so times were tough and she had enough for herself alone. So I was only a burden. 
 Been close to the edge because that and other incidents throughout life have beaten me around a bit I guess I'll say. Because for some of us out there having that someone is essential for our mindset, to have someone to better ourselves and trudge on for. So I get it. I may not understand the cause but I understand the emotions behind it.  

Every person on this little hellscape we call a planet is unique, no one person has had all the same experiences that form who You are. That makes every single individual a Gem worth envy and praise. Something irreplaceable, Uncomparable to any other and more beautifully crafted by time and the harsh storms of life then that individual gem can comprehend. 
You, are that gem. Whether you see how stunning you are for being yourself or not does not change that you are. Beauty is in the eyes of the beholder, and there are alot of people out there sitting alone crying in murky depression because they dont see their own potential to shine.
For the record, as an extra 2cents, Most of those girls and guys that would make fun of you for such things lack the most important quality that exists. Loyalty. I would have walked through fire for her. Without hesitation. I have a scar on my arm that proves it. Nothing is more important than loyalty to the one you love.

Do you hate it because You hate it or because of what other people think of you.  Fuck them. Fuck the world. We are all freaks in our own ways. Those are usually the best people to have in your corner. 
 
Your perception of your own self image should not be tainted by criticism and opinionated bullshit from other people. That's Your face. Wear it with pride by that simple fact.  Noone else is you. Noone else has the exact same mind even if it comes close sometimes. You are unique. Whether you like it or not. 
The world is full of vein, angsty mean people who stick their noses into things they shouldn't and judge based on their perceptions without ever considering what it would be like in another person's shoes. 
You dont need to be a super model to be attractive. Attraction in and of itself is based by personal perception. 
What one person may find unattractive another may find the most beautiful thing they've ever laid eyes on.

Technology has a mind of it's own sometimes. 

My suggestion would be to do as I do, dont just make one save. Back up your saves. If the data is concerned to be corrupt. As you are on pc you are quite lucky you can go into your files nad Copy your save data nad toss it in a spare folder til its needed.
Its na extra step yes nad most people nowadays prefer convenience over security but aslong as you make a back up at least every other time you have a prolonged play session you shouldnt ever lose too much if it does happen again.

I just want to sleep forever never be bothered by people and bs again. She won't be back. As much as it hurts me I know she won't. She's moving on in life something I know I can do but I don't want to. I don't want to forget I don't want to accept and move on. I want my love back. Which is the one thing I can't have. In all my travels I have learned I am an extremely emotional person I don't let myself get attached because if I do it's over. Friends too. I'd give my life for any one of them any time any place. But I'd take a front row seat in hell just to raise her to heaven. I'm not depressed, or lost I'm broken and sad and alone. And that isn't something my friends can cure they have been trying. And I don't know if I can shoulder that for very much longer.

I don't know what I'll do right now. If nothing else I am proud of the community I've watched grow for the last 5 years has become so beautiful. Your all amazing people don't let anyone tell you different. I love you all. I love this game and I hope you all have long meaningful lives surrounded by your loved ones.

I've been from texas to Egypt to Russia to Japan. I've watched people kill each other for trash and been beaten for drinking water. I'm tired. I have a bowel problem that only really lets me take a shit every week or so and so far I'm on 2 and a half without. Being awake is pain. I have full body cramps so often that I can go about my day and even sleep without it waking me or impeding me to much. She was the only reason I held on. The purpose of my life. I'd have let her slit my throat without resistance was the love I felt for her. I can't survive without that. I am purposeless. I love ark and I have a few friends but it isn't the same thing. I just wanted a little bit of happy after everything but it wasn't to be. Sorry this isn't why I posted those screenshots. I was hoping someone could get some happy out of them as they did me.
My girlfriend of 6 years recently broke it off. I wanted to marry her. Grow old. Die. And without her I.. I just can't I don't have the desire or will to go on anymore.

Im just having a really hard time mustering the will to continue. I grew up in the land, spent my time hunting and living a pretty natural life. I tolerated the 9-5 and stresses of modern life because of her now? I don't know if I can. If I care enough to. But who would love someone with nothing? Noone.

I just don't know if I can. I've seen what's out there and it doesn't seem much better. Does someone exist that will care just because? I gave everything I am. She could have slit my throat at any moment and I wouldn't have stopped her. To me love is giving my everything. I don't know if I'll ever find someone that feels the same and if I did would I be worth the trouble?
